<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>החברים של מנדי – לא משאירים אף ילד לבד</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik:wght@300;400;500;600;700;900&family=Assistant:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --yellow: #FFD700;
      --yellow-dark: #E6C200;
      --yellow-soft: rgba(255,215,0,0.15);
      --black: #111111;
      --black-soft: #1a1a1a;
      --gray-dark: #333;
      --gray-mid: #666;
      --gray-light: #fafafa;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --radius: 18px;
      --shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      direction: rtl;
      text-align: right;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    ul { list-style: none; }

    /* ── CONTAINERS ── */
    .container { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }

    /* ── TYPOGRAPHY ── */
    .label {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--black);
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 5px 14px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    h2.section-title {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    p.section-sub {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--gray-mid);
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    /* ── BUTTONS ── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 99px;
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.97rem;
      cursor: pointer; border: none; transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-yellow {
      background: var(--yellow); color: var(--black);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.4);
    }
    .btn-yellow:hover { background: var(--yellow-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(255,215,0,0.55); }
    .btn-black { background: var(--black); color: var(--yellow); }
    .btn-black:hover { background: #222; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .btn-outline { border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #fff; background: transparent; }
    .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--yellow); color: var(--yellow); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       HEADER
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    header {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 200;
      background: var(--black);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    nav {
      max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 28px; height: 80px; gap: 24px;
    }

    /* Logo – large and proud */
    .nav-logo img {
      height: 72px;        /* significantly bigger */
      width: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-logo img:hover { transform: scale(1.04); }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem;
      position: relative; transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links a::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -3px; right: 0;
      width: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--yellow);
      transition: width var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

    /* TODO: החלף את href="#" בקישור לעמוד התרומה שלך */
    .btn-donate {
      background: var(--yellow); color: var(--black);
      padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 99px;
      font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.92rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(255,215,0,0.35);
    }
    .btn-donate:hover { background: var(--yellow-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(255,215,0,0.55); }

    .hamburger { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
    .hamburger span { display: block; width: 26px; height: 2.5px; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; transition: var(--transition); }

    .mobile-menu {
      display: none; flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--black-soft); max-height: 0; overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.4s ease;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { max-height: 400px; }
    .mobile-menu a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); padding: 15px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      font-weight: 500; transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-menu a:hover { background: rgba(255,215,0,0.1); color: var(--yellow); }
    .mobile-menu .m-donate {
      margin: 16px 28px 20px; border-bottom: none;
      background: var(--yellow); color: var(--black);
      border-radius: 99px; text-align: center; font-weight: 800;
    }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       HERO  – dandelion-inspired
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    .hero {
      position: relative; min-height: 94vh;
      background: var(--black); overflow: hidden;
      display: flex; align-items: center;
    }

    /* soft yellow glow matching logo circle */
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 700px; height: 700px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,215,0,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
      top: 50%; left: 55%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Thin organic rings echoing dandelion */
    .hero-ring {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-ring:nth-child(1) { width: 560px; height: 560px; top: calc(50% - 280px); right: calc(50% - 430px); animation: spin 40s linear infinite; }
    .hero-ring:nth-child(2) { width: 380px; height: 380px; top: calc(50% - 190px); right: calc(50% - 340px); animation: spin 25s linear infinite reverse; border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.07); }
    .hero-ring:nth-child(3) { width: 220px; height: 220px; top: calc(50% - 110px); right: calc(50% - 260px); animation: spin 15s linear infinite; border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.14); }

    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    /* Floating seeds */
    .seed {
      position: absolute; pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0; animation: drift 8s ease-in-out infinite;
      font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(255,215,0,0.35);
    }
    .seed:nth-child(4)  { top: 15%; right: 18%; animation-delay: 0s;   font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .seed:nth-child(5)  { top: 70%; right: 8%;  animation-delay: 2s;   font-size: 1.2rem; }
    .seed:nth-child(6)  { top: 40%; left: 12%;  animation-delay: 4s;   font-size: 0.6rem; }
    .seed:nth-child(7)  { top: 22%; left: 20%;  animation-delay: 1.5s; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .seed:nth-child(8)  { bottom: 18%; right: 35%; animation-delay: 3s; font-size: 0.75rem; }
    @keyframes drift {
      0%,100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) translateX(0) rotate(0deg); }
      20%      { opacity: 1; }
      80%      { opacity: 0.6; }
      100%     { transform: translateY(-60px) translateX(20px) rotate(15deg); }
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative; z-index: 2;
      max-width: 660px; padding: 60px 28px;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,215,0,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.28);
      color: var(--yellow); padding: 7px 18px; border-radius: 99px;
      font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 32px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease both;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 900;
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 8.5vw, 5.8rem);
      line-height: 1.04; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 22px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.15s both;
    }
    .hero-title .accent { color: var(--yellow); }
    .hero-slogan {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 500;
      font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin-bottom: 44px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.3s both;
    }
    .hero-slogan strong { color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 700; }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.45s both;
    }
    .hero-stats {
      position: relative; z-index: 2;
      display: flex; gap: 44px; margin-top: 68px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeUp 1s ease 0.6s both;
    }
    .stat-num {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 2rem; color: var(--yellow); line-height: 1;
    }
    .stat-label { font-size: 0.83rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-top: 4px; }

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       PROJECTS
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    .projects { padding: 100px 0; background: var(--gray-light); }
    .projects-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(310px, 1fr));
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .card {
      background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-color: var(--yellow); }

    /* Card hero uses dandelion-motif bg */
    .card-visual {
      height: 190px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .card-visual.lib    { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, #1b1b2e, #0a0a18); }
    .card-visual.praise { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, #2e1b00, #180d00); }
    .card-visual.shop   { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, #0d2e0d, #051205); }

    /* Decorative circle inside card (like the logo) */
    .card-circle {
      position: absolute;
      width: 130px; height: 130px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--yellow); opacity: 0.18;
      top: -20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
    .card-emoji { font-size: 3.8rem; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .card-body { padding: 28px 26px; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .card-tag { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gray-mid); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .card h3 { font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 11px; }
    .card p { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--gray-mid); line-height: 1.65; flex: 1; margin-bottom: 22px; }
    .card-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       ABOUT
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    .about { padding: 100px 0; background: var(--black); }
    .about-inner {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px; align-items: center;
    }
    .about-text .section-title { color: #fff; }
    .about-text .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58); max-width: 100%; }

    .values { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 38px; }
    .value-item {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      border-radius: 12px;
      border-right: 3px solid var(--yellow);
    }
    .value-icon { font-size: 1.35rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .value-text { font-size: 0.94rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); }
    .value-text strong { color: var(--yellow); display: block; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; }

    /* Big quote card mirrors logo composition */
    .about-visual { position: relative; }
    .quote-card {
      background: var(--yellow); border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 52px 44px; text-align: center;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .quote-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; top: -50px; right: -50px;
      width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .quote-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; bottom: -40px; left: -40px;
      width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    }
    .big-quote {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.22; margin-bottom: 18px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .quote-sub { font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.58); position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       CONTACT
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    .contact { padding: 100px 0; background: var(--gray-light); }
    .contact-inner {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
      gap: 64px; align-items: start;
    }
    .contact-info h3 {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .contact-info > p { font-size: 0.97rem; color: var(--gray-mid); margin-bottom: 36px; }

    .contact-detail {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    }
    .contact-detail:last-of-type { border: none; }
    .detail-icon {
      width: 42px; height: 42px; background: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .detail-content span { display: block; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--gray-mid); margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .detail-content a, .detail-content strong { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.96rem; color: var(--black); }

    .social-links { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .social-btn {
      width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 11px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; font-size: 1.1rem;
      transition: var(--transition); border: 1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .social-btn:hover { background: var(--yellow); border-color: var(--yellow); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* Form */
    .form-card {
      background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 44px 40px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }
    .form-card h3 { font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 28px; }
    .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
    .form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .form-group label { font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-dark); }
    .form-group input, .form-group select, .form-group textarea {
      width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px;
      border: 2px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 11px;
      font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif; font-size: 0.97rem;
      color: var(--black); background: var(--gray-light);
      direction: rtl; outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus, .form-group textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--yellow); background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,215,0,0.2);
    }
    .form-group textarea { min-height: 110px; resize: vertical; }
    .form-submit { width: 100%; padding: 16px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .success-msg {
      display: none; background: #f0fff4; border: 2px solid #4caf50;
      border-radius: 11px; padding: 18px 22px;
      color: #2e7d32; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 16px; text-align: center;
    }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       FOOTER
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    footer { background: var(--black); color: #fff; padding: 64px 0 30px; }
    .footer-inner {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 52px; margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .footer-logo img {
      height: 90px; width: auto; object-fit: contain;
      mix-blend-mode: screen; opacity: 0.92;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      line-height: 1.65; max-width: 300px;
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--yellow);
      margin-bottom: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em;
    }
    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      padding-top: 28px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-bottom p, .footer-bottom span { font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════
       RESPONSIVE
    ════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .about-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .contact-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-menu { display: flex; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .projects, .about, .contact { padding: 64px 0; }
      .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .hero-stats { gap: 28px; }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
      .form-card { padding: 28px 20px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════
     HEADER
══════════════════════════════ -->
<header>
  <nav>
    <div class="nav-logo">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="לוגו החברים של מנדי" />
    </div>

    <ul class="nav-links">
      <li><a href="#projects">המיזמים שלנו</a></li>
      <li><a href="#about">אודות</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact">יצירת קשר</a></li>
      <!-- TODO: החלף את href="#" בקישור לעמוד התרומה שלך -->
      <li><a href="#" class="btn-donate">❤️ תרומה לעמותה</a></li>
    </ul>

    <div class="hamburger" id="hamburger">
      <span></span><span></span><span></span>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <div class="mobile-menu" id="mobileMenu">
    <a href="#projects" onclick="closeMobile()">המיזמים שלנו</a>
    <a href="#about"    onclick="closeMobile()">אודות</a>
    <a href="#contact"  onclick="closeMobile()">יצירת קשר</a>
    <!-- TODO: החלף את href="#" בקישור לעמוד התרומה שלך -->
    <a href="#" class="m-donate">❤️ תרומה לעמותה</a>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════
     HERO
══════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <!-- organic rings like dandelion stem/halo -->
  <div class="hero-ring"></div>
  <div class="hero-ring"></div>
  <div class="hero-ring"></div>
  <!-- floating seeds -->
  <div class="seed">✦</div>
  <div class="seed">·</div>
  <div class="seed">✦</div>
  <div class="seed">·</div>
  <div class="seed">✦</div>

  <div class="container" style="width:100%">
    <div class="hero-content">
      <div class="hero-badge">
        💛 עמותה רשומה ע"ר 580814101 · פועלים מהלב
      </div>
      <h1 class="hero-title">
        החברים<br>של <span class="accent">מנדי</span>
      </h1>
      <p class="hero-slogan">
        <strong>לא משאירים אף ילד לבד</strong> –<br>
        כי כל ילד ראוי לחברה, לשייכות ולחיוך.
      </p>
      <div class="hero-actions">
        <!-- TODO: החלף את href="#" בקישור לעמוד התרומה שלך -->

<script>
  // Hamburger
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open'));
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target))
      mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
  });
  function closeMobile() { mobileMenu.classList.remove('open'); }

  // Form
  function submitForm() {
    const name    = document.getElementById('fullname').value.trim();
    const phone   = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();
    const email   = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const subject = document.getElementById('subject').value;
    if (!name || !phone || !email || !subject) { alert('אנא מלא את כל שדות החובה המסומנים ב-*'); return; }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { alert('אנא הכנס כתובת אימייל תקינה'); return; }
    document.getElementById('successMsg').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('successMsg').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
    ['fullname','phone','email','message'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = '');
    document.getElementById('subject').value = '';
    // TODO: כאן ניתן להוסיף שליחה אמיתית – Formspree / EmailJS / fetch('/api/contact')
  }

  // Scroll-aware header
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    document.querySelector('header').style.boxShadow =
      window.scrollY > 50 ? '0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' : 'none';
  });

  // Entrance animations via IntersectionObserver
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.style.opacity = '1';
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.card, .value-item, .contact-detail, .quote-card').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
    el.style.transition = `opacity 0.5s ease ${i * 0.07}s, transform 0.5s ease ${i * 0.07}s`;
    io.observe(el);
  });
</script>
